curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.subStrand: Demonstratives: this, that, these and those
curriculum.outcomeText: use the words this, that, these, those in sentences

interactions.prompt: You hold one pencil. Which sentence fits?
interactions.feedback: Yes! This names one nearby thing.
interactions.retryHint: One thing near you uses this.

interactions.prompt: Match each clue to its pointing word.
interactions.retryHint: First decide one or many, then near or far.

interactions.prompt: Two books are beside you. Complete: ___ are my books.
interactions.feedback: Correct! These names many nearby things.

interactions.prompt: A single tree is across the field. Complete: ___ is a tall tree.
interactions.feedback: Right! That names one faraway thing.

interactions.prompt: Three birds sit on a distant roof. Which sentence is correct?
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Those names many faraway things.

interactions.prompt: Choose the correct pair: one cup near me; two plates far away.
choices: This is a cup. Those are plates.
That is a cup. These are plates.
These is a cup. That are plates.
interactions.answer: This is a cup. Those are plates.
interactions.retryHint: Near one uses this; far many uses those.
